subject: Add sender NULL check in clusterProcessGossipSection invalid_ids case (#12980)
reason: The fix guards a NULL-pointer dereference in clusterProcessGossipSection that occurs only inside the invalid_ids branch: when a node receives a cluster-bus gossip section containing invalid (non-[a-z0-9]) node IDs from a sender it does not yet know (link->node NULL and clusterLookupNode(hdr->sender) NULL). Invalid gossip node IDs never arise from healthy nodes (IDs are hex, always valid) and, as the code comment notes, only indicate memory corruption on the sender; producing them requires injecting a crafted/corrupted cluster-bus packet. The fuzzer reaches servers only via RESP commands/tools
